_comment: NPC ships (docs/MASTER_DESIGN.md sections 6 and 12). Each loadout lists the hull, engine and weapons (ids from equipment.json); the race that built them is the ship's race. Pirates: 'min_danger' (0-1) is how far from the races' home systems a loadout starts to appear ('danger' = distance to the nearest home system / danger_distance), 'hull_hp' is the share of armor they start with (pirates are battle-worn), 'bounty' is what the Ranger Corps pays for destroying one, 'cargo' is [min, max] units of goods they carry (part of it is left in the wreck, plus salvage). Traders: 'cargo' is [min, max] units of goods on board.
